evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models increasingly automate optimization modeling from natural language problems, producing written mathematics, solver code and a returned report.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Verifying one optimization problem across these artifacts requires semantic comparison: unequal models can attain the same objective, equivalent models can use different auxiliary variables, and mutually consistent artifacts can omit the same source requirement.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Across 3,034 problems and six generator sizes, ORSMT improves the model-code match rate in all 72 benchmark and generator combinations before selection.
